request.title: West Palm Beach Civic Participation Accelerator
request.summary: CivicOS Institute seeks support to increase practical civic participation in West Palm Beach through structured engagement programming, partner coordination, and measurable community action outcomes.

program.goal: Increase local civic engagement capacity and documented resident participation.
program.obj1: Engage 300 residents through structured civic participation opportunities.
program.obj2: Support 12 community-led initiatives with operational tools and facilitation.
program.obj3: Produce quarterly impact reporting with KPI-based accountability.
